_source: Response body of GET /wp-json/wc/v3/coupons?_fields=id,code,amount,discount_type,status,date_expires_gmt,usage_count,usage_limit,meta_data&per_page=100&page=1. Objects follow the 'List all coupons' example at https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/apis/rest-api/v3/coupons#list-all-coupons (ids 720 and 719, codes "free shipping" and 10off) reduced to the requested _fields (https://developer.wordpress.org/rest-api/using-the-rest-api/global-parameters/#_fields), plus one GoPayLocal coupon (id 721) carrying the meta GoPayLocal sends. `status` is not in the docs example; it is in the coupon schema of includes/rest-api/Controllers/Version2/class-wc-rest-coupons-v2-controller.php (WooCommerce 11.3.0), value "publish" for a published coupon. The test serves `body` as the response.
